create_commit_operation_add: create a CommitOperationAdd to upload a local file to a Hugging Face Hub repository
create_commit_operation_delete: create a CommitOperationDelete to remove a file or folder from a Hugging Face Hub repository
create_commit_operation_copy: create a CommitOperationCopy to copy an LFS file within a Hugging Face Hub repository
build_commit_payload: build a ndjson commit payload from operations for posting to the Hugging Face Hub /commit API
upload_lfs_files: upload large files to the Hub using the git LFS batch protocol with concurrent threads
